difference.candidate_requirement: After a durable Redis checkpoint, a Redis process crash must not restart the application or duplicate a report. If Redis is unavailable through the bounded queue deadline, return the fixed outbound queue unavailable result with no partial publication; after the same data directory is recovered, an explicit retry must publish exactly one DMARC task and Sent message matching the active golden.
difference.oracle_behavior: Frozen Java keeps the original report request pending while Redis is SIGKILLed and resumes it after Redis restarts from the same RDB/AOF data directory.
difference.candidate_behavior: Rust completes the bounded report queue operation with outbound queue unavailable while Redis is down, preserves the source and pre-existing durable state, and succeeds on an explicit retry after Redis recovers without restarting the application.
difference.reason: Redis process failure must be bounded and recoverable. An application request or worker cannot wait indefinitely on a dead cache, and a retry must not duplicate a publication or lose its durable checkpoint.
difference.scope: Only Redis SIGKILL after exact DMARC DNS discovery, with AOF enabled and SAVE completed before the fault. Healthy queue bytes, TTLs, report MIME/gzip, source rows, Maildir layout, application continuity, and successful recovery publication remain strict.
